summary.text: Rashid Young is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 11 (Bienville, Claiborne and Lincoln parishes), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Rashid Young's occupation as Attorney.
It lists education as B.S., Business Administration, Arkansas Baptist College; J.D., Southern University Law Center.

The page lists committee assignments including Ways and Means and the Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus affiliations including the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
